subject.title: BL-ecommerce-engagement-01: notify requests with unknown EANs are retried forever and never cleaned up

question: Should this issue be resolved by signup validation only, or should the cron also mark pending notify rows terminal when their product no longer exists?
rationale: The two open PRs differ on a business rule: terminal-marking stops daily retries but can also stop a future notification if a temporarily missing product later returns.

options.title: Prefer signup-only policy
options.body: Land the signup-validation path and document that deleted-product pending rows intentionally remain pending unless a separate cleanup policy is approved.

options.title: Adopt terminal orphan cleanup
options.body: Land the broader route-plus-cron fix after accepting that missing-product rows will no longer notify if the product reappears.

options.title: Define a third cleanup path
options.body: Pause both PRs and specify a cleanup or re-subscription rule that avoids indefinite retries without losing legitimate future alerts.

recommendation.title: Prefer signup-only policy
recommendation.body: Land the signup-validation path and document that deleted-product pending rows intentionally remain pending unless a separate cleanup policy is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue identifies Daniel as the BL owner who confirmed the divergence during F2, and the competing fix paths are business-policy choices for that rule.
